name: sre-observability-scaling
description: Use when the user asks about Prometheus TSDB internals, high cardinality or too many series, Prometheus memory usage, compaction and retention, scaling Prometheus, Thanos vs Mimir vs VictoriaMetrics, remote write tuning, or OTel Collector scaling. Produces sizing, tuning and horizontal scaling plans. Not for basic setup (use prometheus-grafana).
